# NP-02 · Information Architecture

Information is ordered by how often people need it: Level 1 is the most frequently accessed, Level 4 the least. Frequent actions are easier to reach than admin actions (Operator: Terima Cucian = 1 tap from home; Owner: Settings = Menu → Sistem → Pengaturan, hidden from every other role).

## Levels

| Level | Nama (Name) | Pertanyaan (Question) | Contoh (Examples) | Untuk siapa (For whom) | Layar (Screens) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| L1 | Saat Ini (Right Now) | Apa yang perlu perhatian sekarang? (What needs attention now?) | 12 Cucian Menunggu, 3 Menunggu QC, 2 Ada Masalah, 1 Terlambat | Semua user. Selalu di bagian paling atas. (Every user. Always at the very top.) | 9 |
| L2 | Pekerjaan Saya (My Work) | Apa pekerjaan saya? (What is my work?) | Terima Cucian, Proses Laundry, QC, Packing, Pengiriman | Sesuai peran. Hanya fitur yang relevan. (By role. Only relevant features.) | 40 |
| L3 | Riwayat & Detail (History & Detail) | Apa yang sudah terjadi? (What has happened?) | Riwayat, Status, Bukti, Catatan, Detail transaksi | Operasional & supervisor untuk lacak dan verifikasi. (Operations & supervisors for tracking and checks.) | 9 |
| L4 | Manajemen & Konfigurasi (Management & Configuration) | Bagaimana bisnis berjalan & diatur? (How is the business run and configured?) | Laporan, Analitik, Master Data, Pengaturan, Persetujuan, Audit | Manajemen. Strategis dan konfigurasi. (Management. Strategy and configuration.) | 19 |

## Role × level

✓ = the role lives in that level (ROLES.levels). The number is how many screens of that level the role can open.

| Peran (Role) | L1 | L2 | L3 | L4 | Pertanyaan beranda (Home question) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Frontline Operator | ✓ 1 | ✓ 13 | ✓ 2 | –  | Apa yang harus saya kerjakan sekarang? (What should I do now?) |
| Driver / Pickup | ✓ 1 | ✓ 7 | ✓ 2 | –  | Ke mana saya hari ini? (Where do I go today?) |
| Laundry Supervisor | ✓ 2 | ✓ 15 | ✓ 2 | ✓ 5 | Apa yang perlu perhatian? (What needs attention?) |
| Operations Manager | ✓ 2 | ✓ 2 | ✓ 2 | ✓ 9 | Bagaimana operasional berjalan? (How is the operation performing?) |
| Finance | ✓ 1 | ✓ 9 | ✓ 1 | ✓ 2 | Apa yang perlu ditagih atau ditagihkan? (What needs billing or collection?) |
| Sales / Account | ✓ 2 | ✓ 9 | ✓ 1 | –  | Klien mana yang perlu perhatian? (Which clients need attention?) |
| Director / CEO / Owner | ✓ 2 | ✓ 6 | ✓ 1 | ✓ 17 | Bagaimana kinerja bisnis? (How is the business performing?) |
| Client Portal | ✓ 1 | ✓ 2 | ✓ 5 | –  | Bagaimana status cucian saya? (What is happening with my laundry?) |

## Alert priority

| Level | Warna (Colour) | Contoh (Example) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Info | blue | 12 cucian menunggu. (12 loads waiting.) |
| Peringatan (Warning) | amber | SLA tersisa 1 jam. (1 hour of SLA left.) |
| Kritis (Critical) | red | Order terlambat. (Order is late.) |

> **Jangan berlebihan memakai merah.** (Do not overuse red.) Red is only for late, failed, or needs action now. Most numbers stay blue; amber warns before it becomes red. Always icon + text, never colour alone.
